scope: Proposal review only; not setup, connection authorization or publication approval.
summary: Current official Buffer API/pricing pages support Buffer Free as a conditional $0 candidate for the proposed X-only original-post workflow. The proposal accurately distinguishes documentation from an authenticated, usable connection and requires exact owner approval before new third-party setup. It preserves uncertain native publications, cadence, the profitable X-sale objective and separate attribution cohorts. No failing criterion or source correction was identified.

inputs.meaning: Current preservation snapshot at review time; this owning status file may receive later review links.

independent_public_sources.supports: Buffer expressly identifies X among its official API partnerships; its API includes Free access and account/channel/queued-post operations. An account/key and appropriate organization ownership are prerequisites.
independent_public_sources.limits: These are vendor documentation claims, not proof of this owner's eligibility, permissions, working connection or visibility into X-native schedules. No reply authorization follows.

independent_public_sources.supports: Free is advertised with up to three channels, ten queued posts per channel that can be refilled, and one API key. This capacity is compatible with the bounded proposed cadence if the actual account qualifies.
independent_public_sources.limits: No paid trial, billing entry, quota upgrade or additional channel is authorized. The root's reported daily-limit discrepancy is retained; no numeric daily allowance is promised.

checks.method: Ten bounded criteria checked against local JSON/text, hashes, current status and two direct official public source reads.

results.check: Frozen plan hash matches EVIDENCE; current execution target is the exact Dress Like Mommy X profile.
Free/API/partner/queue claims have official-source support and are explicitly conditional; no unsupported daily request allowance is promised.
Proposal states not connected/not created; new_connection_approved is false and exact owner approval precedes setup.
Supported API-backed original-post/readback route is required; X website automation and automated replies are not authorized.
Only @dresslikemommy is proposed; actual Free plan, account identity and normal permission scope must be checked; charges, trials, billing entry and extra channels remain excluded.

Seven historical native submissions remain protected; R002 is publication-unverified and current native pending count unknown. No Buffer import/copy/replay or complete historical-visibility inference is permitted.
Existing three-to-four originals/week and one/day limits remain; R010/R011 are at most one later option, with current content/destination/media gates and a distinct actual publication receipt.
First verified profitable X sale remains the goal; actual X attribution and costs are required; unknown outcomes and separate article/Pinterest cohorts are preserved.
The existing 09:00/16:00 operation remains unchanged; proposal records no new account, draft, recurring task, spend or platform mutation.
Rollback affects only the newly granted connection, never existing X content/queues; credential handling stays outside chat/repo and the old existing-publisher question is not repeated.

preservation_snapshot.effort_note: Existing limit remains in current execution state; no full weekly-effort certification or expansion is made.

exact_setup_blocker: Exact owner authorization for the proposed new Buffer Free connection has not been provided. The existing organic mandate is not represented as approval for this third-party setup.
post_approval_gates: Normal owner sign-in/authorization and compatible permissions, with only the approved X channel.
Actual Free plan, required account privileges, exact connected identity and successful supported API retrieval without a charge.
Actual available posting slot and duplicate checks that preserve uncertain native submissions; Buffer queue visibility is not X-native queue proof.
Reviewed exact original content, current destination, relevant media/disclosure checks and durable X publication readback.
adversarial_challenge: Published Free/API features can be mistaken for an already usable account or complete X history. The plan avoids that leap by making account/permission/readback verification prerequisites and preserving uncertain native work.
credible_alternative: Use an existing supported publisher already available to the owner, if one is identified and its exact account/scope can be verified, before establishing new third-party access.
limitations: Exactly two public source reads were made: Buffer API and pricing. Buffer X/Quick Start/support and X-rule references in the packet remain root-supplied; the twice-timed-out detailed help URL was not retried.
No account eligibility, OAuth screen, API key, integration configuration, live queue, posting, native ALT/crop/disclosure or sales result was tested.
Vendor Community or AI-reply feature listings do not confer X automated-reply permission, and this proposal excludes such replies.
Any setup requiring a charge, incompatible permission scope or uncertain identity remains held.
next_action: Root may present the exact Buffer Free connection proposal for owner authorization. Continue only from an actual response; this review does not authorize setup.
